data.body: Confirmed on origin/main@4c9940348148fb255b17ddf1cb124701ad4565d7: make worktree name=comment-gates-current created the branch/worktree, then failed provisioning because the repository requires uv==0.12.7 while the host uv is 0.12.9. The target left the worktree with no usable .venv and exit 2. Non-global workaround succeeded: uvx --from uv==0.12.7 uv venv --python 3.12 .venv; uvx --from uv==0.12.7 uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra metrics; env PATH="/Users/joeoakhart/comment-gates-current/.venv/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/System/Cryptexes/App/usr/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/var/run/com.apple.security.cryptexd/codex.system/bootstrap/usr/local/bin:/var/run/com.apple.security.cryptexd/codex.system/bootstrap/usr/bin:/var/run/com.apple.security.cryptexd/codex.system/bootstrap/usr/appleinternal/bin:/pkg/env/global/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby@3.4/bin:/opt/homebrew/lib/ruby/gems/3.4.0/bin:/Users/joeoakhart/.codex/tmp/arg0/codex-arg0spyp95:/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources:/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.14/libexec/bin:/Applications/Visual\ Studio\ Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin:/usr/local/opt/postgresql@17/bin:/Users/joeoakhart/.local/bin:/Users/joeoakhart/.lmstudio/bin" make hooks. This confirms the mismatch is a current-main bootstrap defect, not stale-branch behavior.
